concerns.text: The UQ‑method table (section *UQ Methodology*) pairs each uncertainty technique with a different baseline model (GPR → GPR, MC Dropout → small MLP, Deep Ensemble → same MLP, Split‑Conformal → XGBoost). This conflates model architecture with the UQ method, making it impossible to attribute differences in calibration or sharpness to the uncertainty technique alone.

The plan uses Formation Energy as a proxy for Elastic Modulus (see the *Problem Statement* and *Construct Validity Note*). While the limitation is acknowledged, the downstream claim that results inform “mechanical stiffness” remains scientifically weak; the construct mismatch may invalidate any conclusions about elastic properties.

The power analysis assumes ≥200 test samples per dataset will be sufficient after Bonferroni correction (adjusted α≈0.00278). No quantitative power calculation is provided; for small effect sizes this sample size is likely under‑powered, risking a high false‑negative rate.
